note: Printed words that name a control drawn directly above them, and how to locate that control on the current frame. This file holds IDENTITY and a RELATION, never a click position: 'template_path' is a picture of the control, matched on the frame in front of the run, and the tap target is wherever the match IS. Constitution A §24.2 forbids a stored coordinate as a tap target and §24.4 forbids reading a historical position to click; §24.3 explicitly allows a bounded search region, which is what 'search' records. A record may also carry 'allow_measured_block': true, which lets the measured-block gate run when no crop exists yet -- it is off by default because that gate failed its own calibration (see docs/LOCAL_PLANNER_ACCEPTANCE.md §7).

evidence.verified_by: 50 of the 58 PLAN_TARGET_IS_NOT_A_CONTROL refusals in learning/local_planner_steps.jsonl name this control, on page_key UNKNOWN::城墙; the model reply itself reads "目标为继续建设生产力，当前城墙升级条件已满足，点击升级按钮即可推进。"
evidence.why_registered: The element table typed a printed button as TEXT_LABEL, so the model named it correctly and was refused. 50 of 58 refusals are this word.
evidence.why_no_template: The manifest holds a verified crop (BTN_BUILD_UPGRADE, 升级/UPGRADE) but it contains the button countdown, which this project disqualifies, and it measures at most 0.2864 over 75 real frames against a 0.7 threshold -- it matches nothing, not even the button.  With label_is_the_control the control region is the box this frame OCRs for the word, which is measured, not stored.
evidence.measured_specificity: the same crop over 75 real frames: max 0.2864, 0 of 75 over threshold; that crop is NOT used, only recorded here
evidence.recall: UNMEASURED -- no current frame draws the wall panel, so no positive exists yet
